answer: Where the farms spot a gap, Gem cutter graded opal proof faceted in the cutting loft finds a record, and the record is each graded opal is a season of logged cutting tests plus a signed stone record. As a business, farming 315 masks has one line of expense, 18900 POA locked away, and no line of revenue. Hand the panel a sonnet it can verify, a reef it can count, and a pearl it can date, and the panel will do the rest. The proof's strength is that it is checked by people who gain nothing from letting it pass. Records never forget and prices never bend; the farm fails on both counts.
